name: EffectCraft v0.9.2
body:
## What's Changed
* Share docking transactions and preserve viewer lifecycle by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/689
* ci: refactor workflows to use storytold/craft-common-actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/801
* #678: dropped Photoshop files show the Import Photoshop File dialog by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/734
* #729: import STL 3D models (binary and ASCII) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/735
* #730: Composition ▸ Copy Frame to Clipboard by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/737
* #738: Edit ▸ Paste pastes SVG markup as a shape layer by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/739
* #303: Mesh Warp's grid can be dragged in the Composition viewer by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/740
* Graph Editor: Shift constrains Bezier handle drags to one axis (#723) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/743
* #732: toolbar Fill/Stroke Options change the selected shape layers' kind by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/744
* #474: decoding a multi-layer EXR no longer holds the file's samples twice by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/746
* #750: float footage follows Working Gamma and is encoded once by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/752
* #741: font menu filters to variable fonts by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/761
* #758: layers, property groups and properties are callable by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/763
* #757: Transitions animation presets in Effects & Presets by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/764
* #759: #include / //@include / #includepath in scripts by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/771
* #776: Project panel arrow-key navigation and accessible names by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/780
* #773: run repeating app.scheduleTask tasks until cancelTask by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/781
* Text: the variable-font test picks an axis that moves the advance by @FeiLiuEM in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/399
* Shapes: edit gradient color and opacity stops (#612) by @tylerjenningsw in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/694
* Pixel Motion Blur: synthesize from motion vectors, honour Vector Detail (#535) by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/695
* #596: GPU Information names the adapter, or why the GPU compositor is off by @didpublishing in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/699
* Match After Effects non-legacy Brightness & Contrast by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/702
* Tests: six engine tests no longer assume the working directory's drive on Windows by @didpublishing in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/703
* Settings: allow custom UI scale percentages (#682) by @tylerjenningsw in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/705
* fix(viewer): create a composition when dropping footage onto an empty viewer by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/709
* fix(effects): add XYZ rotation to CC Cylinder on CPU and GPU by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/711
* fix(gpu): cap GPU readback staging buffers to prevent memory exhaustion by @mjohnson7cd in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/713
* CI: FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 nightly and on release, not per PR by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/716
* Contributors: add vangel76 (Valentin Klein) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/728
* #710: Timeline ruler labels frames when Time Display is Frames by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/731
* #473: Cryptomatte Selection keeps quoted names with commas whole by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/733
* Tests: an imported animated GIF plays its frames (#651) by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/677
* #736: import FBX 3D models (binary and ASCII) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/742
* #315: Front / Bevel / Side / Back Color for extruded shapes and text by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/754
* #745: import Targa (.tga) and Radiance HDR (.hdr) stills and sequences by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/755
* #756: import DPX and Cineon stills and sequences by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/765
* #767: import MXF (OP1a / OP-Atom) footage by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/769
* #760: $.evalFile and a minimal BridgeTalk host identification by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/772
* #770: Proportional Scrubbing of Timeline values (Ctrl+Alt / Cmd+Opt) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/774
* #766: ScriptUI mouse events reach script listeners by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/775
* #372: uncompressed QuickTime (raw RGB / ARGB) output module format by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/778
* Layer panel: zoom and pan; View zoom acts on the focused viewer; Roto Brush hint (#753) by @redonion23 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/824
* UI: wrap the Footage panel's empty hint in a narrow panel by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/825
* UI: favorite themes and appearance shortcuts by @luniiya in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/826
* Window: remember the window's size and position between launches by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/829
* pt-BR: translate the panels below the menu bar by @WladmirJunior in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/830
* Shortcuts: Cmd+Left / Cmd+Right Arrow step a frame by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/835
* fix(script): preserve raw bytes in BINARY File reads, writes, and copies by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/842
* fix(script): keep Undo command ID 16 stable for scripts by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/843
* fix(script): preserve atomic undo groups beyond the history limit by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/844
* feat(script): delete keyframe ranges in one undoable command by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/845
* fix(script): persist layer comments and unnamed marker parameters by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/846
* fix(script): expose AVLayer transform property shortcuts by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/847
* fix(script): respect ImportOptions.importAs for layered PSD files by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/850
* fix(script): preserve item and layer wrapper identity by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/851
* fix(script): expose After Effects text Path Options matchNames by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/852
* UI: leave no gap between the rows of a menu by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/854
* Timeline: U and UU reveal Time Remap by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/857
* #762: import animated WebP as footage with its frames by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/768
* Translate the 95 panel rows Ukrainian was missing by @MishynMykhailo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/782
* #329: scrubbing a long movie: superseded viewer frames call off their decodes by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/784
* #779: fuzz File > Open; refuse deeply nested XML projects by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/785
* #486: move a panel into its own native window (multiple monitors) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/787
* #788: hold opened projects and size commands to the 30,000 px limits by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/789
* #595: RAM preview prefetches nearest the playhead and keeps the frames just ahead by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/793
* #794: open movies in place instead of reading them whole by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/796
* Keep footage dropped on the timeline at its full length (#795) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/798
* Automation: a layer or comp id sent as a string resolves as an id (#749) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/799
* #786: fuzz expressions; fix the overflows, hangs and panic it found by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/806
* Performance: reduce UI stalls while dragging layers by @cdinhoo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/807
* Import: stills and movies respect their orientation by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/827
* fix(script): implement ExtendScript String.substr compatibility by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/849
* Fix full-screen shortcut shown on Windows by @nanox333 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/934
* Open Essential Graphics from blank Timeline context menu by @nanox333 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/936
* Timeline: trim all selected layers together by @Themolx in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/950
* Effects: Fractal and Turbulent Noise stay inside the layer's alpha (#939) by @HEOJUNFO in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/951
* Fix: rename expression control by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/953
* engine: build well-formed file:// URLs for Edit Original, Reveal and File.execute by @SteamSmith in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/954
* SVG: percentages inside a nested <svg> resolve against its own viewport by @webdevtodayjason in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/969
* Fix #958: add vector conversion to layer context menus by @nanox333 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/979
* Fix #978: widen Project Settings dialog by @nanox333 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/980
* Control: ui.click / ui.drag hold their modifiers for the whole gesture by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/130
* Viewer: each composition keeps its Resolution in the project, as in After Effects (#417) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/462
* Effects: text and shape layers run their stack over the whole layer region (#659, #658) by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/686
* Window menu: show check marks next to visible panels [skip ci] by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/861
* Shapes: drag gradient start and end points in the Composition viewer (#612) by @tylerjenningsw in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/862
* Save the active comp and open comp tabs in project files (#748) by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/863
* UI: draw the ▸ menu-path separator instead of a missing-glyph box by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/865
* Timeline: UU reveals modified options and layer styles, without false positives by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/867
* #866: Layer ▸ New ▸ Text starts typing into Source Text by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/868
* Track Matte: picking a mode without a matte layer takes the layer above (#864) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/869
* i18n: add Russian, French and German menu catalogs by @pechnikov2026-star in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/873
* #874: scan Flatpak host, XDG and fontconfig font folders on Linux by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/876
* #875: layout views draw camera and light wireframes by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/877
* #880: motion paths with overflowing or NaN arc length evaluate without panicking by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/883
* #881: Tab in the Project panel's rename field commits and keeps the keyboard by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/884
* #886: say why footage the decoders can't read shows no picture by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/887
* #882: pixel-exact Composition viewer at 100 % and above by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/888
* #890: Timeline time field round-trips its timecode at 29.97/59.94 fps by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/891
* Text: stop capturing keyboard input after clicking away (#831) by @tylerjenningsw in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/892
* #878: context menus act on the whole selection by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/893
* Scripting: text range selectors resolve by match name and limit the animator (#837) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/895
* #670: each pane of a 2- or 4-view layout chooses its own view by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/899
* #903: downmix 5.1 and other multichannel audio to stereo by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/904
* Shape layers: always rasterise at the on-screen scale (#751) by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/906
* Shapes: the toolbar's gradient swatches open the Gradient Editor (#612) by @tylerjenningsw in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/907
* UI: draw concave icons as convex pieces (fixes Selection arrow, Speaker, Sparkle glyphs) by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/913
* Viewer: Fit up to 100% follows the panel size by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/916
* UI: keyboard shortcuts for dialog answers by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/919
* Timeline: Alt-click an A/V feature switches the other layers by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/921
* UI: dialogs open with their first text field focused and selected by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/922
* Desktop: write log records to standard error and a rotating log file by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/923
* Resume an open mask path when the Pen clicks its last vertex (#912) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/924
* Interpret Footage: apply the Loop (times) value sent as a float (#909) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/925
* Cap text animator range selector Start, End and Offset (#908) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/926
* fix: View > Go to Time accepts the dialog's float frame [skip ci] by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/927
* Release workflow: pass the Azure signing secrets by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/928
* #637: double-clicking a layer's bar acts like its name; text layers edit their text by @aniliashenko in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/930
* Composition Settings: save and delete your own presets by @aniliashenko in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/935
* Keep GPU Information dialog layout steady by @nanox333 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/937
* Scale the timeline waveform by the layer's Audio Levels (#974) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/983
* Show the Continuously Rasterize switch on vector footage layers (#957) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/984
* i18n: add Czech (cs) interface language by @Losminek in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/987

## New Contributors
* @skylartaylor made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/689
* @vangel76 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/734
* @didpublishing made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/699
* @redonion23 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/824
* @pravdomil made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/825
* @WladmirJunior made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/830
* @MishynMykhailo made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/782
* @nanox333 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/934
* @Themolx made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/950
* @SteamSmith made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/954
* @webdevtodayjason made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/969
* @pechnikov2026-star made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/873
* @aniliashenko made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/930
* @Losminek made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/987

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.2

name: EffectCraft v0.8.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Land 49 community PRs, with follow-ups by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/598
* i18n: add Brazilian Portuguese (pt-br) UI translation by @RicSchonfelder in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/217
* G2: Fix effect self-inputs, CC Composite, and control activation by @cdinhoo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/423
* Add rendered-frame fidelity scoring by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/427
* Fix live preview freezing during rapid property edits by @cdinhoo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/442
* Viewer: the shape tools draw their own shape while dragging, and a layer drag moves the picture by @Aavirash in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/443
* ui: import dropped media files with a drop-target hint by @David-T-Campos in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/447
* Render Essential Graphics templates from CLI values by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/451
* MCP: return on write errors while stdin is open; document requests during a render by @storybored379 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/458
* Add Spanish (es) UI translation by @llopjulen in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/460
* Relink missing footage by scanning a folder for compatible files by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/461
* i18n: Japanese for the panels, dialogs and tooltips (396 rows) by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/469
* Preserve 3D child position when changing parents by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/471
* i18n: Ukrainian panels and platform Reveal labels (#333) by @dmatviichuk in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/472
* fix: CLI --bitrate now applies to VP9 WebM (#440) by @mjohnson7cd in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/478
* Scripting: importFile(ImportOptions) imports one file unless sequence is set (#475) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/479
* Expressions: Add Expression applies to the selected properties (#476) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/480
* EXR: do not double the part name of Blender 5 per-pass parts (#481) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/487
* i18n: the text the interface below the menu bar draws reaches the catalog by @cjcwwww in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/490
* Preserve exact frame boundaries and timecode cancellation by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/497
* Fix web playback performance with stacked footage by @daijro in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/507
* Return to Settings after dismissing GPU Information by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/512
* chore: bump github actions to fix Node 20 deprecation warnings by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/516
* docs: register the MCP server from an installed release by @sawizzle in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/517
* Appearance modes: sync with system and separate light/dark themes by @luniiya in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/519
* fix(engine): layer.setText schema requires optional OpenType keys (#520) by @mjohnson7cd in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/521
* Honor explicit time bases in property and keyframe commands by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/522
* Preserve keyframe selection order during attribute edits by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/524
* Issue #543: Scripting: layers.addSolid keeps the requested pixel aspect by @LloydNicholson in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/555
* Preserve exported audio sample positions at work-area starts by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/556
* PDF: bound what any stream filter may decode to by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/557
* Scripts: a script name is a file name, not a path by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/558
* fix(script): honor Item.selected=false while retaining other Project selections by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/559
* fix(script): keep pending TextDocument baseline reads in sync (#549) by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/560
* fix(expr): keep pending TextStyle baseline getters in sync by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/561
* fix(app): open .ecprojx files passed to the desktop executable by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/562
* fix(engine): validate new text layer positions without panicking by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/563
* fix(render-queue): accept Render Settings templates when adding jobs by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/564
* fix(render-queue): honor height-only edits with locked aspect ratio by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/565
* fix(script): deselect individual properties with Property.selected=false by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/566
* Import animated GIFs as movies by @Limestudio90 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/567
* i18n: wrap hardcoded UI strings for Chinese localization by @seldoms in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/571
* Preserve the shown panel when removing inactive tabs by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/573
* PDF colour spaces and functions: bound sizes, depth and stacks by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/575
* Tests: four failures on Windows (autosave paths, GPU viewer adapter, audio preview race) by @KattKnight in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/579
* macOS: projects open from Finder; .pcraft is PhotoCraft's again by @LloydNicholson in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/582
* Clarify property-group errors in property commands and MCP by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/299
* Progress docs: re-measure parity against After Effects 2026 26.5 by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/617
* Land community PRs, batch 2, with follow-ups by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/639
* Reload Footage shows new pixels and keeps Photoshop layers; Reload Footage Changed on Disk by @KattKnight in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/578
* Rotation: dragging the degrees field can go negative by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/584
* Effect reset: restore parameters inside twirl-down groups by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/585
* Support continuous numeric scrubbing across monitor edges by @kikikikier in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/592
* Add inline font family search in Character and Properties by @kikikikier in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/593
* Preserve reachable history branches during trimming by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/597
* Keep work-area edits inside the composition by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/605
* Move separated Position on canvas resize and crop by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/606
* Move layers when Position is edited with separated dimensions by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/607
* Show a layer through its first Intersect or Darken mask by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/608
* Startup: a launch that stops as its window is shown switches the next to OpenGL (AMD Vulkan crash) by @JeremyYao in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/589
* Land community PRs, batch 3, with follow-ups by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/643
* Keep the playhead on the displayed current time by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/610
* Start Linux audio preview without a silence preroll by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/614
* Interface: probe Hangul so Korean text isn't drawn as boxes (#599) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/616
* Viewer: passive Composition viewers apply the monitor color conversion (#547) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/618
* Locked viewer: re-convert pixels when the display profile or output simulation changes (#546) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/619
* Effects: CC Power Pin Unstretch reverses the pin mapping (#534) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/620
* CC Simple Wire Removal: Frame Offset takes the strip from the previous or next frame (#533) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/621
* Rove Across Time keeps roving keys off the neighbouring fixed keys' times (#532) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/622
* Convert Expression to Keyframes: sort the keys by layer time on a time-reversed layer (#531) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/623

name: EffectCraft v0.4.0
body:
## Highlights

A release built around the issues people filed since v0.3.1: more than 40 of them are fixed.

- **Timeline:** Alt+wheel zooms out to the whole comp; the Time Navigator's ends drag to zoom and `;` toggles frame level / the whole comp; reveal shortcuts (U, E, P…) only touch the selected layers; enabling Time Remapping reveals it; Project items land where you drop them.
- **Viewer:** drop Project items, files and effects straight onto the comp; Pan Behind snaps the anchor to its own layer, with Alt-drag, Shift-drag and Ctrl+double-click to center; a locked viewer keeps its comp.
- **Panels and editing:** clicking a value or name field selects it, so typing replaces it (Enter commits, Escape cancels); the gaps between the right column's stacked panels drag to resize them; Delete removes selected animators, masks and shape groups; the font menus list your installed fonts.
- **Export:** VP9 WebM frames always decode (no false superframe markers); long audio keeps its sound past 12:36; `--format hevc` / `av1` and `.mp4` outputs keep the codec you chose; AV1 WebM refuses alpha instead of silently dropping it.
- **Reliability:** running out of video memory falls back to the CPU instead of crashing; GPU start-up failures are contained; the CLI no longer panics when its output is piped into `head`.
- **Agents and automation:** MCP `add_effect` is one undo step and all-or-nothing; expression syntax errors reach `set_property` replies; unknown CLI options are errors; `docs/agents.md` lists every MCP tool, checked by a test.
- **Platforms:** Windows on ARM64 installers, tested on ARM64 hardware.

Thanks to everyone who filed issues and sent pull requests. Come say hi on [Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).

* Windows on ARM64: release builds, PE header check, install test on ARM64 hardware by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/101

name: EffectCraft v0.3.0
body:
## Highlights

**Trained models: optional downloads, open source, pure Rust**
- **Roto Brush** 2.0 / 3.0 can use **MobileSAM** (Apache-2.0, 40 MB).
- **Face Tracking** can use Google's **MediaPipe Face Landmarker** (Apache-2.0, 3.8 MB).
- Download and choose them in Settings ▸ Roto Brush / Face Tracking, or with `roto.model.*` / `face.model.*`. Each is checked against its published SHA-256 and kept with a notice crediting its authors.
- Nothing is bundled: the installers stay small. The classic engines remain built in.

**New in the app**
- **View ▸ New Viewer:** several Composition viewers.
- **Audio scrubbing:** Ctrl/Cmd-drag the current-time indicator.
- **Nested comp markers** on precomp layer bars.
- **RAM preview frames keyed by content:** undo, and edits in other comps, keep cached frames.
- **GPU on wgpu's OpenGL backend:** FreeBSD, and Linux without Vulkan.

**Fixes from your reports.** Thank you, everyone who filed issues!
- **Viewer:** scaling a layer by its handles now follows the mouse (#63). The viewer keeps up while you drag a layer (#65). There's one 3D compass instead of two (#64).
- **Links:** the Discord buttons, Help links and Settings links open your browser again (#68).
- **Project panel:** double-click its empty area to import (#44). Its details no longer clip (#45).
- **Linux:** the AppImage shows the EffectCraft icon on Wayland (#43).

**Known limitation:** on Wayland, files can't be dragged into the window yet; the windowing library (winit) doesn't support it. Start the AppImage with `WAYLAND_DISPLAY=` to use XWayland, where dropping works.

## What's Changed
* CI: fix Packaging lint (SC2015 in release.yml) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/53
* M4.14: content-keyed RAM preview frames (M4 done); proxies in the disk cache key by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/54

* M13.34: audio scrubbing (Ctrl/Cmd-drag the current time) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/57

* M13.36: face tracking trained model (MediaPipe Face Landmarker, pure Rust) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/61
* Release: EffectCraft v0.3.0 by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/62
* GPU on wgpu's OpenGL backend (FreeBSD / Linux without Vulkan) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/69
* FreeBSD: system info reports memory, CPU model and OS version by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/60
* Fix #68: Discord buttons and other links open the browser again by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/73
* Fix #63: scaling a layer by its handles follows the pointer by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/74
* Fix #64: one 3D compass in the viewer by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/76
* Fix #65: the viewer keeps up while a layer is dragged by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/77
* Test #46: docking by the panel menu button and resizing by the gutters by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/78
* Fix #45: the Project panel's details stay inside the panel by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/79
* Fix #43: the AppImage's window shows the EffectCraft icon on Wayland by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/80
